title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
hook_text: Google DeepMind built an anti-scam AI.
script:
Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore are collaborating to stop financial fraud.
They designed a fine-tuned model to intercept active conversational scams.
The system runs lightweight Gemma models directly on personal devices.
It operates inside private chats without sending data to the cloud.
Previous security tools required external servers to process chat contents.
This local approach keeps personal conversations entirely private from servers.
GovTech Singapore aims to block scammers before users reply to messages.
Would you trust your phone to block scammers?

editor.one_line: Strong factual reporting dragged down by static, repetitive abstract 3D visuals.
visual_notes: line 1: Unrelated abstract red waves holding too long across multiple frames.
line 4: Repetitive abstract graphics that do not illustrate private chat or cloud egress.
line 5: Static abstract rendering with no visual connection to external servers.
line 6: Holding the same text card without visual reinforcement of local privacy.
